name: Full hit dice on a long rest
author: Alexandria
summary: A long rest gives back every spent hit die, not just half.

rules.text: At the end of a **long rest** a character regains **all** spent hit dice, instead of half their total.

assistant.dm: Long rests restore all spent hit dice at this table, not half.
assistant.player: At this table a long rest gives back all your spent hit dice, so spend them freely on short rests.
